name: BMW R1200RT
engine: 1170 cc air/oil-cooled boxer twin (to 2013) or liquid-cooled boxer (2014-on), fuel injected, shaft drive
intro: BMW's boxer tourer. Several recalls over the years, including the 2014 Dynamic ESA rear shock.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls first
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. 2007-2009 bikes are in recall 09V256 (brake lines may leak). Some 2005-2010 bikes are in recall 15V141 (rear wheel flange). 2014 bikes with Dynamic ESA are in recall 14V320 (rear shock rod can break, with a do-not-ride warning). Older R1200s also had fuel pump flange recalls (13V617 and 20V471).
A-002.reason: A broken shock or leaking brake line is a crash risk. Every fix is free.

add.title: Lube the drive splines
add.instructions: Pull the rear drive and clean and grease the shaft splines with a moly paste. Look for oil in the swingarm.
add.reason: Dry splines wear and fail. Most owners forget to grease them.

H: 2014-on RTs are liquid-cooled. Earlier ones are air/oil-cooled and have no coolant to change.

recalls.what: Aluminum rear wheel flange can let the wheel bolts loosen.
recalls.fix: Dealer fits a steel rear wheel flange free.

recalls.what: Rear shock piston rod can break without warning.
recalls.fix: Dealer replaces the Dynamic ESA shock free.
